name: Peacock
overview: Scripture mentions peacocks as valuable and exotic creatures associated with wealth and trade, as seen in the accounts of King Solomon's navy bringing peacocks alongside gold, silver, ivory, and apes (1 Kings 10:22; 2 Chronicles 9:21). Additionally, the book of Job highlights the distinct and splendid wings of the peacock, emphasizing God's creative design in giving them their beautiful feathers (Job 39:13). These verses collectively point to the peacock as a symbol of God's provision and artistry in creation.
